desc: A rare phantom knight, empty suit of lavender armor with a helmet, two arms and two legs, cold teal glow inside the visor, holding a broken sword. Not an animal. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body with empty margin, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no background.
